events.title: Push Notifications
events.description: Hack Forums now has native push notification support across Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Chrome for Android. Members are prompted to allow or deny notifications.

events.title: Notification Bug Reports
events.description: A thread was opened to gather bug reports and suggestions for the renovated notification system.

events.title: Vibes section introduced
events.description: A new 'Vibes' section was added to HF News, featuring spiritual, inspirational, and philosophical content along with weekly horoscopes.
